title: California home with hidden miniature town and working railway sells for $415,000
summary_full: A stunning home in East Hemet, California, has recently changed hands, boasting a remarkable model train city as its centerpiece. This three-bedroom, two-bath residence also features a luxurious pool and spa, enhancing outdoor enjoyment. The property's elaborate train setup adds to its allure, capturing the interest of buyers looking for a unique property. The final sale price reflects both its distinctiveness and competitive positioning in the local real estate market.
